note: Protocol validation for the parameter-efficiency ablation. One configuration -- the selected model, trial 61 -- re-run under the trimmed training protocol (val_every_frac 0.5, min_delta 0.02, patience 2 epochs) on the same three seeds used for seed validation. Under the original protocol this configuration scored mean 0.7921, sd 0.0032. Acceptance rule, stated before running: the trim is adopted if the paired mean difference is within +/-0.01, the same equivalence margin used for configuration selection. If it is not, the ablation runs under the original protocol and costs about five hours more.
